### Help for Unbelief
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/help-unbelief
Passage: Mark 9:24
Points:
- Saving faith entails personal trust in Christ, not merely knowing about Him as demons do.
- The desperate father models genuine faith despite its weakness and imperfections.
- The power of faith rests in its object—Jesus Christ—rather than the strength of the believer's faith.
- Even weak faith receives Christ's mercy, yet believers are called to pursue maturity through prayer and Scripture.

### Even in the “If”
Author: Jackie Smith-Bell
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-26-2024.html
Passage: Mark 9:24
Points:
- Protracted trials and crises can stir deep doubts about God's willingness or ability to help.
- The father's hesitation exposed his wavering confidence, which Jesus gently addressed and redirected.
- God welcomes honest confessions of our doubts and anxieties instead of feigned strength.
- Remembering the Lord's past faithfulness sustains our trust while waiting for His answers.

### The God Who Works With Our Uncertain Faith
Author: Kia Stephens
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-8-2022.html
Passage: Mark 9:24
Points:
- Exhausting, long-term personal struggles often make our problems seem bigger than God's power to resolve them.
- Jesus accepted and acted upon the father's fragile, honest plea for help.
- Divine power always exceeds the scale of whatever circumstances we face.
- Trusting God means resting in His care even when His timing and solutions differ from our expectations.

### A Prayer to Help Us Believe
Author: Kristine Brown
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-help-us-believe.html
Passage: Mark 9:24
Points:
- When confronted with overwhelming needs, fear of unanswered prayers can hinder bold faith.
- Wavering often comes from holding back control rather than completely depending on the Lord.
- Christ recognizes our human frailty and invites us to ask for help with our unbelief.
- Surrendering our doubts to God relieves the anxiety of trying to control life's outcomes.
